subject.title: improve(ui): move Sessions from the sidebar More menu into Settings

question: Should upgrades intentionally remove users’ persisted Sessions sidebar pins when Sessions moves into Settings, while preserving only the legacy URL alias?
rationale: Tests establish the proposed behavior, but whether an existing customized navigation preference should be reset is a product and upgrade-policy choice.

options.title: Accept the pin reset
options.body: Land the move as proposed, treating Sessions as administration that should no longer be pinnable in the primary sidebar.

options.title: Preserve a shortcut
options.body: Provide an equivalent supported shortcut or migration behavior so existing customized access is not silently removed.

options.title: Keep the current placement
options.body: Leave Sessions in customizable sidebar navigation until the broader Settings information architecture is settled.

recommendation.title: Accept the pin reset
recommendation.body: Land the move as proposed, treating Sessions as administration that should no longer be pinnable in the primary sidebar.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged sidebar information-architecture work makes this person the strongest available owner for the placement and upgrade-behavior decision.
